metadata.title: Micron and other chip stocks slip as election results strike at the core of data-center optimism - MarketWatch

content.text:
Tech Stocks
Micron and other chip stocks slip as election results strike at the core of data-center optimism
Democratic victories in Texas and other states raise long-term questions about the AI buildout, though they do not ‘unwind projects already funded’
A “blue wave” in Tuesday’s midterm elections not only led to Democratic control of both chambers of Congress, but also saw the party win key governors’ races by pledging a tougher tack on data-center construction.
A key question for investors now is what the new political backdrop means for chip and infrastructure stocks, as Wall Street’s forecasts depend heavily on new data-center capacity coming online.
